title: Interested in being a Poll worker for the Neighborhood Council Election?
description:
Make a difference in your community.
Serve as a poll worker in Neighborhood Council Elections.
Individuals interested in serving as poll workers in Neighborhood Council Elections must be 18 years of age or older; submit an application by the appropriate deadline and commit to working the entire voting hours. Poll workers will receive compensation for working on Election Day.
  
Applications must be received by our office no later than 30 days prior to the election date. 

APPLY NOW : https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScVyC2OewrQ8tZh4w1m_zwmHgEvWcQL3KxCzGS1Irko3BV4oQ/viewform
